main_text.l: לילית f. Strix, avis noctu volans, scribit Ab. Esr. Jes.34.14. Lamia, juxta quosdam.
לִישׁ m. Leo vetus : לָבִיא וְלִישׁ Immanis Leo, vetus leo, Jesa.30.6. Vide אַרְיֵה.

לָכַד Cepit, Occupavit, Deprehendit : Futurum cum Aff. יִלְכְּדֶנּוּ Capient ipsum, Prov.5.22. pro נִי [?] : Vide simile in קבב . Niph, נִלְכַּד Captus, Deprehen-sus fuit; Partic. הַנִּלְכָּד Qui deprehensus fuerit, Jos.7.15. Futur. יִלְכֹּד Capietur, Jesa.24.18. Hithp. Fut. יִתְלַכְּדוּ Comprehendunt se, Job.41.8. Metaphoricè, יִתְלַכָּדוּ Concrescunt, Congelantur, Job.38.30.
מַלְכֵּדֶת fæm. Decipula: Aff. וּמַלְכִּדָתוֹ Et decipula ejus, Job.18.10.

לָמַד Didicit : Praeter. וְלֹא לָמַדְתִּי חָכְמָה Neq, di-dici sapientiam, Prov.30.3. Pih. לִמֵּד Discere fecit, Docuit, Eccl.2.9. לִמַּדְתַּנִי Docuisti me, Psal.71.17. Pyh. Praeterit. לָמֵד Edoctus, Assuetus, Jer.31.18. in Ka-metz propter pausam, quamvis etiam Participium prae-sens esse possit, Part. Praet. Const. מְלֻמְּדֵי שִׁיר Docti musi-ces, 1.Par.25.7. fœm. מְלֻמָּדָה Edocta, Jes.29.13.

לָמוּד vel לָמֵד m. Eruditus, Doctus, Assuetus, Jer.2. v.24. Plur. לִשּׁוֹן לְמוּדִים Linguam eruditorum, Jes.50.4. Const. לְמוּדֵי יְהוָה Edocti à Domino, Jes.54.13. Aff. בִּלְמֻדַי Inter peritos meos, id est, qui à me edocti sunt, hoc est, disci-pulos meos, Jesa.8.16.
לְמוּר m. Peritus: Plural. Const. וּלְמוּדֵי מִלְחָמָה Periti belli, 1.Par.5.18.
* כִּלְמַר Kilmad, Medorum provincia, vel Kilmadus populus, Ezech.27.23. Quibusdam est appellativum con-structum.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms (e.g. "pro" entry at line 3, the Hebrew after "Vide simile in") are uncertain at this scan resolution and are marked [?] where doubtful. Printed "Jef." and "Pfal." read as Jes. and Psal. (long s). Printed "Esr." read as Esr. The final word "structum" is printed as the continuation of "con-". No catchword, signature or margin notes.
